_comment: Catalogue keys with no use in src/ at wave 4 (strings for features not built: shortcuts overlay, calibration dot states, modification credits, a few tips and errors). en.json is frozen, so they are tracked here instead of deleted. The lint fails on any key not listed and on any listed key that gets used, so this list can only shrink. Wave 1 (copy package) added the redesign keys from 05 sections 13.1, 13.2 and the designer's notes ahead of the screens that consume them; later packages remove each entry as they use the key.
